keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «유나가 편지를 보냈지만 답장이 오지 않았다(문제)» 와 «작은 병 하나가 바다 건너 큰 우정을 실어 날랐다(메시지)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Yuna wrote to Leo, but no answer came) and the message (a small bottle carried a big friendship across the sea). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Yuna wrote to Leo, but no answer came for a long time.
Yuna and Leo became friends and talk every week in English.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: I live on a small island in the Philippines.
land with water all around it
There was an email address at the bottom.
the place where you send letters or emails
a very strong storm with wind and rain
A small bottle carried a big friendship across the sea.

qs.q: Why didn't Leo answer Yuna for a long time?
qs.qko: 레오는 왜 오랫동안 유나에게 답장하지 않았나요?
opts: A big typhoon hit his island, and there was no electricity.
Leo did not want to be friends.
Yuna wrote to the wrong address.
evs: A week passed, and then a month.
One summer morning, Yuna found a green bottle on a beach in Busan.
"Sorry! A big typhoon hit my island, and we had no electricity for weeks."
There was an email address at the bottom.
why: 레오는 큰 태풍이 섬을 덮쳐서 몇 주 동안 전기가 없었다고 했어요. 그래서 답장을 못 보냈어요. 친구가 되기 싫었다는 말은 없어요.
Leo said a big typhoon hit his island, and they had no electricity for weeks. That is why he could not answer. He did want to be friends.

qs.q: "Yuna felt silly." What does "silly" mean here?
qs.qko: "Yuna felt silly."라고 나와요. 여기서 "silly"는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: Yuna wrote to Leo that night, but no answer came.
Yuna sent him photos of her school, and Leo sent pictures of turtles on his beach.
Now they talk every week in English.
Inside was a letter in English.
why: 유나는 편지를 보냈지만 답장이 오지 않았어요. 오래 기다려도 소식이 없으니, 괜히 기다린 것 같아 «바보같이» 느껴진 거예요.
Yuna wrote to Leo, but no answer came. After waiting so long, she felt a little foolish, or «silly».

qs.q: How did Yuna know where to send her message to Leo?
qs.qko: 유나는 레오에게 어디로 소식을 보내야 하는지 어떻게 알았나요?
opts: Leo's letter had an email address, so she wrote to him.
Her teacher gave her Leo's phone number.
She threw a new bottle into the sea.
evs: There was an email address at the bottom.
Then one evening, her computer beeped.
Yuna wrote to Leo that night, but no answer came.
A small bottle carried a big friendship across the sea.
why: 편지 맨 아래에 이메일 주소가 있었고, 유나는 그날 밤 레오에게 글을 썼어요. 그래서 컴퓨터로 소식을 주고받게 되었어요.
There was an email address at the bottom of the letter, and Yuna wrote to Leo that night. That is how they started writing to each other.

ends: Yuna and Leo meet for the first time in Busan.
Yuna's class sends books to help Leo's island after the typhoon.
유나네 반이 태풍을 겪은 레오의 섬에 책을 보내 도와요.

write.src: “If <u>we write in English</u>, we can <u>make friends around the world</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «어떤 상황 + 그때 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write a situation and what we can do then in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «If» 뒤에는 «누가 + 무엇을» 을, «we can» 뒤에는 동사를 바로 쓰세요. (예: If we work hard, we can win the game)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «If», write who + what. After «we can», write a verb. (e.g. If we work hard, we can win the game)

img.cover: On a sunny beach in Busan, a girl with long black hair in two low pigtails and a yellow star hairpin in a sky-blue summer dress lifts a green bottle with a rolled-up paper inside out of the foamy waves, while far across the shining blue sea, a boy with short wavy brown hair in an orange T-shirt waves from a tiny island with palm trees.

scenes.1: In a small bedroom at night, a girl with long black hair in two low pigtails and a yellow star hairpin in a sky-blue summer dress sits at her desk with her chin in her hands and stares at a quiet computer, with a green bottle and a rolled-up paper next to the keyboard and the moon outside the window.
scenes.3: In a bright bedroom, a girl with long black hair in two low pigtails and a yellow star hairpin in a sky-blue summer dress laughs at her computer, where a boy with short wavy brown hair in an orange T-shirt waves on the screen and holds up a photo of two sea turtles on a sandy beach.

alt.1: Yuna waits at her quiet computer at night.
alt.3: Yuna and Leo talk on the computer.
